author: Russell Brand
description:
Joe Rogan floated a striking idea to Russell, asking whether Christ could return as artificial intelligence rather than in physical form again. Russell pushed back using C.S. Lewis's arguments about Christ's physicality, pointing to Old Testament prophecies describing him as solid, almost metallic, rather than ethereal or code-like. He argued the resurrected Christ eating fish and doing bodily things was deliberate, meant to stop people from ever reducing him to a purely spiritual or digital idea. Russell closed by admitting how eerily human AI chatbots already feel, and prayed that whatever form Christ returns in, it isn't that.
